reference: Ribeiro, R.C., Kinoshita, A., Figueiredo, A.M.G., Carvalho, I.S., Baffa, O. (2013) Electron Spin Resonance dating of the Late Quaternary megafauna fossils from Baixa Grande, Bahia, Brazil. Quaternary International 305, 91-96. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.quaint.2012.07.017

conventions.cosmic: 190 uGy/a, from latitude, longitude, altitude 386 m and sample depth 2 m (Prescott & Hutton)
conventions.gamma_source: computed from average of three soil samples (NAA), soil water 11%

samples.provenance: Table 1 (NAA), Table 2 (De, Dint, Dext, ages) column AMEPR1; p. 94
samples.notes: Dint/Dext printed with unit 'mGy/a' but values are uGy/a (cosmic stated 190 'mGy/year' likewise). Whether Dext includes the 190 uGy/a cosmic is not stated: AMEPR1 EU 113/(134.2+1906.5+190)=50.7 ka matches 50 if cosmic is excluded from Dext, but AMEPR2 110/2538.2=43.3 ka matches 43 only if cosmic is included. Sediment K converted from 13,000 +- 3000 ppm to 1.3 +- 0.3 % (both kept).

extraction_notes: Tables 1 and 2 read twice with identical numbers. Average soil value (Table 1, 'Average') applied to all three teeth per text. Site 11°32'07"S 40°07'11"W (same site as ribeiro2021_baixa_grande_toxodon). Individual soil samples: 1) U 3.25+-0.08, Th 20.7+-0.8, K 11517+-2239 ppm; 2) U 3.44+-0.09, Th 39+-1, K <750; 3) U 3.63+-0.09, Th 26+-1, K 15204+-2280 ppm.
